title: Dropbox: Director, Product Design
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US: Select locations
Role Description
Dropbox’s Design team is looking for a Director of Product Design to define the next generation of product experiences and infrastructure for Dropbox. In this role, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for the systems, patterns, and operating model that shape how Dropbox builds coherent, high quality, multi product experiences at scale.
We are building a modern system that can support a broader portfolio of products, accelerate product teams to achieve product market fit, improve front end quality, and create durable patterns for the most important product experiences across Dropbox. You will lead the team responsible for turning repeated product needs into reusable experience infrastructure: interaction patterns, product frameworks, design primitives, implementation standards, and adoption models that make it easier for teams to build excellent Dropbox experiences.
As Director, you will oversee the evolution of Dropbox’s design system into a next generation design and technology platform. This includes the foundational system of components, tokens, accessibility standards, and documentation, but also the broader lifecycle of product patterns: how they are identified, designed, validated, built, adopted, measured, improved, and eventually deprecated. You will help move the team from a reactive model, where design systems patternize work after the fact, to a more proactive model, where the team helps shape core product experiences from the beginning.
You will also establish Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality. This team should not only define what good looks like, but help build it. That means partnering deeply with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, brand, and leadership to create high leverage patterns that improve product coherence, accelerate execution, and raise the quality bar across web, mobile, desktop, and emerging AI native experiences.
The ideal candidate is a systems minded design leader with excellent product judgment, strong craft standards, deep experience leading multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to operate across strategy, execution, governance, and organizational influence. You should be equally comfortable defining a long term vision for the future of design systems, reviewing the details of a complex interaction pattern, partnering with engineering on implementation quality, and helping senior leaders understand where the product experience needs stronger horizontal investment.
This is a critical leadership role for Dropbox’s multi product future. You will help define how shared product experiences are built, how teams adopt them, how quality scales, and how Dropbox creates a more coherent, intelligent, and durable product experience for customers.
Responsibilities
Define and drive the vision for Dropbox’s next generation design system, expanding it from a component library into a broader product experience platform for patterns, primitives, standards, and shared product logic.
Lead Design Systems and Design Technology as a center of excellence for front end product quality, interaction patterns, accessibility, implementation standards, and cross product experience coherence.
Build and evolve reusable product patterns that drive core Dropbox experiences, including navigation, creation flows, sharing, permissions, collaboration, onboarding, search, content activation, notifications, settings, admin workflows, and AI assisted experiences.
Move the team from reactive patternization to proactive product leadership, helping identify horizontal product needs early and shaping solutions that can scale across multiple Dropbox surfaces and teams.
Own the full lifecycle of shared patterns and components, including discovery, definition, design, prototyping, engineering partnership, adoption, measurement, maintenance, governance, and deprecation.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Brand, Marketing, and Design leadership to align on the highest impact horizontal opportunities and ensure shared systems directly support product strategy.
Raise the craft and quality bar across Dropbox by improving interaction design, visual quality, information architecture, accessibility, motion, content patterns, implementation fidelity, and front end consistency.
Create an operating model that makes adoption desirable rather than mandated, ensuring product teams see the system as a way to move faster, build better, and reduce duplicated effort.
Lead and develop a team of designers, design technologists, and systems specialists, creating clear ownership, strong critique practices, high standards, and a culture of pragmatic systems thinking.
Partner with engineering leadership to improve the relationship between design systems, code, product infrastructure, and front end delivery, ensuring that design intent is translated into high quality implementation.
Establish durable governance, measurement, and contribution models that help the system evolve continuously while maintaining quality, coherence, and accountability.
Help Dropbox prepare for AI native product experiences by defining systems that can encode design knowledge, guide product decisions, and support more adaptive, contextual, and intelligent experiences over time.
Requirements
12+ years of product design, design systems, design technology, or front end experience, including significant experience leading complex systems or platform initiatives at scale.
5+ years of people management experience, with a strong track record of leading senior designers, managers, design technologists, or multidisciplinary systems teams.
Deep experience building, scaling, or transforming design systems for complex multi product organizations.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect systems work directly to customer value, product strategy, execution speed, and business impact.
Exceptional systems thinking, with the ability to see patterns across teams, products, platforms, and workflows, then turn those patterns into reusable experience infrastructure.
High craft standards across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, accessibility, prototyping, content patterns, motion, and implementation quality.
Proven ability to influence senior cross functional partners, create alignment across ambiguous problem spaces, and drive horizontal product quality without relying on mandate alone.
Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering with front end engineering teams on component architecture, implementation standards, platform constraints, quality control, and system adoption.
Experience defining governance models, contribution models, quality standards, documentation practices, and lifecycle processes for shared product systems.
A clear point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, design infrastructure, and reusable product logic should change how teams design and build.
A collaborative, low ego leadership style, with a track record of developing talent, raising standards, improving critique, and helping teams produce better work than they could have produced on their own.
A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong design leadership, systems strategy, product impact, organizational influence, and excellent taste.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading design systems, design technology, front end platform, or product infrastructure teams in a large scale, multi product organization.
Deep understanding of how to leverage content systems as part and parcel of the overall design system.
Experience building shared patterns for complex product domains such as collaboration, content management, permissions, search, productivity, AI, administration, or multi product ecosystems.
Strong technical fluency across coded systems, design tokens, component architecture, accessibility infrastructure, prototyping tools, and front end implementation quality.
A strong point of view on the future of design systems, including how AI, design technology, and reusable product logic should evolve the way teams design and build.

With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. At its core, the AI Strategy Consultant role centers around driving marketing strategy and transformation in enterprise organizations.
Today, most marketing communications are planned weeks in advance on a calendar based on dates and internal priorities. Each email, push, campaign takes 3-5 people and dozens of steps to create. Our customers come to us looking to transform the way they do marketing: using AI agents to rapidly learn about consumer preferences and deliver highly effective marketing and product experiences to each customer 1:1.
As an AI Strategy Consultant, you are the trusted technical–strategic partner for our AI Decisioning customers. You own the bridge between what the product can do and what the customer’s business needs — from discovery through go‑live and expansion.
You’ll work with as a part of a driven and creative team of ML + product engineers, product designers, and other Strategy Consultants to deploy new use cases with the largest customer-facing brands in the world. You’ll immerse yourself in our customer’s marketing organization. You’ll partner with customer teams and explore the data, and plunge into the product landscape to help us scale. The problems you’ll work on require a curious and analytical approach, sharp product intuition, and the ability to use insight to improve decisions.
No two days are the same, but you can expect to:

As an agile-oriented eCommerce company, we serve global enterprises and help build online sales for brands. We provide measurable results through performance-based custom strategies tailored to your needs. We are passionate about helping businesses grow faster and more efficiently. title: Social Media Strategist
description:
We are seeking a Social Media Strategist to build and grow a personality-led social media presence from the ground up.
This is a hands-on, end-to-end role covering strategy, account setup, content planning, production management, publishing, audience growth, community management, and performance optimization across Instagram and TikTok. You will work closely with the founder to establish a distinctive online identity and develop it into a recognizable, highly engaging social presence.
Responsibilities
Build and launch the Instagram and TikTok profiles from zero, including positioning, tone of voice, content pillars, visual direction, and channel strategy
Develop and execute the organic growth strategy, with a focus on reach, engagement, follower growth, and long-term audience development
Create viral campaign concepts, social-first stories, and repeatable content formats that establish a distinctive and recognizable online personality
Manage the full content lifecycle, including research, ideation, scripting, content calendars, production coordination, approvals, publishing, and optimization
Use platform analytics, audience insights, watch time, retention, and engagement data to guide creative decisions and improve performance
Manage day-to-day community engagement and coordinate with the founder and creative partners
Requirements
Proven experience launching and organically growing Instagram and TikTok accounts from an early or zero-follower stage
A strong portfolio of high-performing, viral, or culturally relevant social content supported by measurable growth results
Deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms, audience behavior, retention, discoverability, engagement, and organic growth mechanics
Strong creative strategy and social-first storytelling skills, with the ability to turn a personality into compelling and repeatable content
Hands-on experience managing social media end to end, from strategy and content development through production, publishing, analytics, and community management
Strong project management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with the founder and creative production partners
Able to work PST hours
Nice to Have
Experience working with creator-led brands, founders, entertainment properties, personality-driven accounts, legal brands, or character-led content is advantageous but not required

title: High-Ticket Financial Sales Specialist & Team Lead Track
description:
Position: Account Executive / B2B Sales Specialist
Compensation: 100% Commission (Uncapped Earning Potential)
Location: Remote (Global)
About Funding Solutions Experts (FSE)
At FSE, we deliver elite capital solutions to high-growth businesses. We operate in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment where excellence is the standard, not the exception. We do not offer a "comfortable" corporate safety net; instead, we provide a launchpad for the top 1% of sales professionals who want absolute control over their financial destiny through a pure meritocracy.
If you are a self-motivated Closer who thrives in a high-volume, performance-driven environment, this is your opportunity to build an empire.
The Mission: Execute. Close. Lead.
High-Volume B2B Engagement: Conduct focused outbound campaigns (Monday – Friday) targeting business owners and C-suite executives.
Pipeline Management: Manage high-ticket financial sales cycles from initial contact to close, maintaining an authoritative and consultative approach.
Accelerated Leadership Path: We are scouting future Team Leaders. Once you consistently hit your benchmarks, you will be given the autonomy to recruit, train, and scale your own regional "Pod." You will earn direct overrides on every transaction your team closes.
Candidate Profile: The Top 1%
Commanding Communication: Your professional business English is flawless, authoritative, and persuasive. You don't just pitch; you influence key decision-makers.
Relentless Execution: You possess an elite work ethic, show up with high energy every single day, and view "No" as a brief detour on the path to a contract.
Performance Mindset: You excel in high-volume outbound dialing environments. You view critical feedback as revenue-generating data and adapt instantly.
Track Record: Proven experience in high-ticket closing, B2B sales, or financial services is highly preferred.
What FSE Offers
Uncapped Commission Structure: There is no ceiling on your income. Your revenue generation directly dictates your lifestyle.
Rapid Career Progression: We promote strictly on results, not seniority. Transition into a leadership role with team overrides within months of proven success.
Global Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world, provided you have a high-speed internet connection, a quiet workspace, and an elite daily output.
High-Performance Culture: A zero-drama environment focused exclusively on execution, scale, and financial growth.
Are You Ready to Dominate the Market?
If you have the resilience, the drive, and the skill set to close high-ticket financial deals, we want to hear from you.
Apply today to join an elite team of financial sales professionals.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.
We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.
Duties
· Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients
· Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success
· Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required
· Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.
· Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines
· Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues
· Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management
· Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment
· Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices
· Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives
Our Technology Stack
· Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA
· Documentation – Hudu
· RMM – Intune / Immybot
· Networking – Meraki
· Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365
· Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon
· Door Access – Avigilon
Qualification
· 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support
· Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry
· Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service
· Proven experience leading IT projects
· A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications
· Background in providing direct end-user support
· High level of attention to detail
· Excellent verbal and written communication skills
· IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)
· Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents
Our Core Values
Dream Big, Then Make it Real
We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell.
Client Driven Results
Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed.
Own Your Progress
We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.
We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: Maven Clinic: Design Lead, Consumer
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA; Remote, US
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com
An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:
TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
Fortune Change the World (2024)
CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)
We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.
About the role
We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.
It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.
You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.
You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.
You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.
The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.
What we’re looking for
You may be a strong fit if you have:
7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.
Experience formally managing or leading design teams.
Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.
A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.
Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.
Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.
A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.
We’d especially love to see
Experience in healthcare, women’s health, telehealth, digital health, insurance, fintech, marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, or another regulated or trust-sensitive domain.
Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.
Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.
Location and working model
This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.
The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.
Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C., we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.
Benefits That Work For You
Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:
Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting
These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.
Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com .

title: Customer.io: Account Manager, EMEA
description:
Headquarters: EMEA Remote
About Customer.io
Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.
About the role
Hi, I'm Matt Lane, Manager of Account Management at Customer.io , and I'm looking for an Account Manager to join our EMEA team. title: RETR: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://retr.app/
Why this role matters now
A loan officer's business runs on relationships. Ours runs on making sure RETR never gets in the way of theirs.
When something breaks for a customer, a real deal is on the line, and what they need is a person who understands both the product and their business. That person is you.
Most support jobs are a treadmill: you answer the question, the question comes back, you answer it again. Here the work compounds. A good answer becomes an article, the article teaches our AI, and the question stops coming. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, so you can watch the queue shrink because of something you wrote.
What you'll do
• Be the first human a customer talks to, across email, chat, and phone, for individual and enterprise accounts alike
• Answer the hard half. Our AI handles the routine questions; what reaches you is the ambiguous, the technical, and the high-stakes
• Write and improve the knowledge base articles that make the AI better and the queue smaller. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, and we fix the ones that fail
• Build real fluency in mortgage and real estate workflows, deep enough to explain our product in the customer's language rather than ours
• Take actions that carry weight: refunds, cancellations, and billing corrections in Stripe
• Surface product friction to Engineering with enough evidence that it gets fixed, then tell the customer when it ships
• Hand inbound leads to Sales cleanly. Support does not sell, but Support is often the first to touch a future enterprise deal
The first 90 days
Two things in this job reach customers at scale without a human in between: the knowledge base, which feeds our AI, and our enterprise accounts. A knowledge base article that is 80 percent right makes the AI wrong for everyone who asks. So neither one is handed to you on a calendar date. Both are handed over when you have earned them.
Days 1 to 14. Product and customer mastery. Learn what every search does and why a customer would use it. Read every knowledge source we have. Study the queue, open and closed. Start answering emails and chats.
Days 15 to 30. Triage with ease. Route what you cannot answer to the right place. Start taking phone calls, which demand faster answers than anything written.
Day 30. You can run the inbox alone, handle refunds and cancellations, and walk a customer through troubleshooting without help. You will run a mock demo of the platform with your manager playing the customer.
Day 60. You start owning knowledge base articles. If a customer asks something twice, you write it.
Day 90. Full coverage, including enterprise, to the white-glove standard those customers expect. The test that matters: your manager can be offline for a week and nothing breaks.
We would rather ramp you properly than throw you at enterprise in week three and apologize to a customer for it.
The team
Two people. You report to our Customer Support Manager. She reports to our COO. That is the org.
You will also work directly with Engineering on bugs and escalations, with Customer Enablement on onboarding, and with Sales on inbound leads. We are twelve people. Everyone reaches across.
The stack
• Support. HubSpot for tickets, SLAs, and reporting. Aircall for phone. Stripe for billing.
• AI. An AI agent handling first-line resolution, tuned against a knowledge base you will help own.
• Product. The RETR platform: search, lists, exports, alerts, and enterprise account management.
What we're looking for
• 1 to 3 years in a customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
• Genuine patience and real critical thinking. Most of what reaches you will not have an obvious answer
• You explain the why behind an issue rather than just the fix, because that is what builds trust
• Sharp attention to detail in how you document requests, troubleshooting steps, and interactions, plus the instinct to see a problem before it lands
• You would rather fix the root cause than close the ticket
• Comfort with support tooling and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
• Curiosity about AI as a tool you shape, not a threat you resent. A meaningful part of this job is making the machine better
Bonus. Familiarity with the mortgage or real estate industry, or another regulated and technical field.
How we operate
Three philosophies we run by:
• Give more than you get.
• Lead with value.
• Do the right thing.
Five values behind them: Honesty. Integrity. Fairness. Accountability. Excellence.
You'll love this job if you already operate this way. If you don't, we're not the right fit for you.
“Give more than you get” is the one that shows up most in this job. It is the difference between answering the question a customer asked and answering the question they were actually trying to solve. We may not always be able to go the extra mile, but we can always go the extra inch.
What we offer
• $52,000 to $58,000 base salary. National band, no geo-adjustment
• Fully remote, US-based
• Company-paid medical at 100% of your individual premium
• Dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability employer-provided
• 401(k) with match: 100% of your first 1% plus 50% of your next 5%
• 15 days PTO plus 13 paid holidays, including Christmas Eve and the day after Thanksgiving
• $100 weekly meal stipend, $100 monthly wellness stipend
• Full home office setup: laptop, monitors, camera, peripherals provided
What we don't offer
• Big-tech RSUs. We're bootstrapped. No stock grants.
• Bureaucracy. We're small and we like it that way.
• A ticket queue you disappear into. What you learn from customers reaches the people who build the product, in the same week.
• A script to hide behind. Our customers are people building businesses, not numbers in a queue, and we answer them that way.
How to apply
Send a resume and a short note to jobs@retr.app answering one question: tell us about a question you got asked so many times that you did something about it. What did you change, and did it work?
We read every application. If there's a fit, we'll set up a conversation.
We're an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
More at retr.app.
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/retr-customer-support-specialist

description:

Hi there, I'm Mehak , interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team.
About the role
As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales.
Responsibilities
In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.
Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets.
Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots.
Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor.
Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions.
Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language.
Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins.
What you’ll bring
We're looking for someone who:
Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.
Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment.
Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS.
We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far.
Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager.
Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite.
Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly.
Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use.
Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift.
We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply.
Bonus skills
While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have:
Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution.
Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM.
Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget.
Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels.
Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool
What’s in it for you?
Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process.
Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world
Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs)
Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
* Check out the countries we currently hire from here

Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities
Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches
Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being
Interested?
At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone!
When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.
We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Coinbase: Machine Learning Engineer, CX Intelligence
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Brazil
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. As a Machine Learning Engineer on this team, you'll design and scale the agentic systems that automate complex customer support workflows, connecting LLMs with internal APIs and tools to deliver fast, accurate, and compliant AI-powered experiences for millions of customers.
What you'll do:
Architect multi-agent systems using advanced orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Google ADK) to automate complex customer support procedures end-to-end.
Build and scale integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect LLMs with internal Coinbase APIs, databases, and third-party tooling.

Implement RAG, fine-tuning, and prompt engineering techniques to ensure chatbot responses are grounded, accurate, and compliant with Coinbase policies.
Ship production-ready Python services that are resilient, low-latency, and capable of handling Coinbase-scale traffic across asynchronous microservices.
Partner with Conversation Design and Product to translate complex business logic into executable agent procedures within the decentralized architecture.

title: Yoko Co: Front-End WordPress Developer
description:
Headquarters: McLean, VA
URL: https://www.yokoco.com/
We’re seeking a Front-End Developer who wants to make the world a better place through clean code, thoughtful craftsmanship, and a genuine love of building great websites.
This isn’t just about turning designs into code, it’s about translating ideas into experiences, solving problems along the way, and taking pride in the details that make a site feel right. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys the craft of front-end development, cares about doing things the right way, and is always looking for a better, more efficient way to build.
Why work at Yoko Co?
Do good, better: We exclusively serve clients who make a positive impact on the world. This is your chance to build things that help create a better place for all of us.
4-day flex week and lots of holidays. Mondays are flex days, meaning you’re free to take them off if you’re caught up on your work. Plus, we’re closed for nearly a full week at Thanksgiving (November), and two weeks at the end of the year, plus a bunch of other days, too.
High performance, no jerks. You’ll collaborate with good people who believe in doing great work. Best Place to Work (and that’s not just our opinion).
We’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and Washington Business Journal. We value team members who are motivated by our mission and driven to make a positive impact.
If you have a passion for excellence, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.
What you’ll do:
As part of our development team, you’ll build websites and features from design references, turning Figma files into clean, maintainable, production-ready code. Our primary stack is built on Gutenberg block themes, so you’ll spend most of your time there, though you may also work on traditional WordPress themes and, occasionally, other page builders.
Build websites and site features from design references, using industry-standard code and best practices
Develop and maintain WordPress block themes using Gutenberg, templates, parts, patterns, and theme.json configuration
Work with traditional WordPress themes when needed, and occasionally with other page builder platforms
Write clean, well-structured HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Build or extend front-end functionality using React or similar component-based approaches when the project calls for it
Use Git and GitHub for version control, following team branching and code review conventions
Work within a continuous deployment workflow, ensuring changes move smoothly and safely from development to production
Troubleshoot cross-browser and cross-device issues to ensure consistent, polished results
Collaborate with designers, project managers, and strategists to bring projects to life
Look for new and more efficient ways to deliver our work, whether that’s through better tooling, reusable components, or refined processes
Contribute to internal documentation, component libraries, and knowledge sharing
Stay current with WordPress, Gutenberg, and front-end development trends and best practices
What we’re looking for:
We’re less concerned with rigid checklists and more interested in capable, thoughtful developers who care about quality and enjoy solving problems. Strong candidates typically have:
Fluency in WordPress, with experience building both traditional themes and Gutenberg block themes
Comfort working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript Experience translating design references (Figma or similar) into accurate, responsive, production-ready code
Familiarity with Git workflows and collaborative development practices
Experience working within a continuous deployment or CI/CD pipeline
Experience working with tools like Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex
An eye for detail and a commitment to clean, maintainable code Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Fluent English for written and spoken communication
Bonus points:
Experience building custom Gutenberg blocks
Experience with React or similar component-based frameworks
Experience working in a multi-client or agency environment
You may not want to apply if…
You prefer 100% concrete specs handed to you with no ambiguity and no changes. We do our best to provide final, locked designs and specs, but things inevitably change as a project progresses
You’re not interested in learning or working within Gutenberg block themes
You’d rather work solo than collaborate with designers, PMs, and strategists
You’re reluctant to incorporate AI into your workflow
Front-end development here is a mix of code and configuration, and often requires curiosity, flexibility, and a willingness to find the most efficient path to a great result.
What you get:
You’ll get a flexible schedule, unlimited time off, a competitive salary, a profit share bonus (starting in your second year), the ability to work wherever you want, a personal development budget, and all US federal holidays and multiple weeks off at the end of the year to recharge. We’ll also offset your entire carbon footprint. If you’re in the US, we also offer health insurance, disability and life insurance, and 401(k) matching.
More about us:
We’re a group of people who are passionate about the work we do, the clients we serve, and improving our craft. We also care about each other — we don’t think of one another as coworkers or employees, but as fellow humans. From developers to designers, project managers to strategists, we bring out the best in each other.
We’ve been in business for over a decade, our whole team is remote, and we’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and the Washington Business Journal.
To apply:
If you’re interested, fill out our application form . An actual human from our team looks at every submission. As much as we’d like to, we can’t promise that we’ll reply to every application.
P.S. We encourage you to include a video message!

title: Collibra: Director, Facility Security Officer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, East Coast USA
Joining Collibra Public Sector LLC (CPS)
Collibra Public Sector LLC (CPS) is a DCSA-cleared entity operating under an approved Proxy Agreement (PA) and Affiliated Operations Plan (AOP) as a FOCI-mitigated subsidiary. The Director, Facility Security Officer (FSO) will serve as the principal security advisor to CPS’s Government Security Committee (GSC) and the company's primary interface with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) and other cognizant security authorities. Additionally, the Director will be responsible for developing, implementing, and ensuring compliance with our Insider Threat Program and be the designated FSO and Insider Threat Security Officer (ITPSO).
This is a foundational leadership role within CPS. The Director will own the ongoing execution and maturation of CPS’s policies in accordance with the National Industrial Security Program. The Director will ensure full compliance with the PA and AOP between CPS and the parent company. The FSO reports to the CPS General Manager and operates under the oversight of the GSC. This role requires independence and a thorough understanding of the obligations that govern FOCI-mitigated entities, facility clearances, and personnel clearances.
The Director, Facility Security Officer is responsible for
FOCI Compliance and Proxy Agreement Execution
Serve as principal advisor to the GSC on all matters related to the PA compliance and any other applicable matters.
Maintain and enforce all obligations under the approved PA and APO, including visit controls, the Electronic Communications Plan, and the Technology Control Plan.
Serve as the primary point of contact with DCSA for all matters related to facility clearances, annual compliance reporting, and all FOCI mitigation oversight.
Review and approve all affiliate contacts, visits and communications between CPS and the parent company in accordance with the approved visit controls procedures.
Develop and maintain a FOCI mitigation instrument (Security Control Agreement, Special Security Agreement, or equivalent) in coordination with outside counsel on FOCI mitigation matters and any open compliance questions.
Establish and maintain all required DSS/DCSA-mandated records, plans, and programs.
Personnel Security
Administer personnel security clearance processing end-to-end via JPAS/DISS, including nominations, investigations, and visit certifications.
Advise employees and managers on clearance eligibility, adjudicative guidelines, and ongoing reporting obligations.
Maintain a current and accurate roster of cleared personnel and access authorizations.
Insider Threat & Security Education
Lead Collibra's Insider Threat Program, including a multi-disciplinary hub and reporting mechanisms.
Develop and deliver annual and ongoing security education and awareness training for cleared and uncleared personnel.
Conduct self-inspection programs and prepare for DCSA facility reviews and annual compliance audits.
Governance & Stakeholder Management
Serve as a trusted advisor to the General Manager and the GSC senior leadership on all security and compliance matters related to the government business.
Partner with independent legal counsel on export control compliance, including ITAR/EAR obligations as they intersect with CPSs products and services.
Support contract compliance and bid activities requiring security documentation or clearance certifications.
Coordinate incident investigations involving potential unauthorized disclosure, fraud, or insider threat, and ensure prompt reporting to GSC and DCSA as required.
You Have
8+ years of experience as a Facility Security Officer or in a substantially similar industrial security role within a cleared defense contractor environment.
Deep working knowledge of the NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117), DAAPM/Risk Management Framework, and DCSA oversight processes.
Demonstrated experience managing or supporting FOCI mitigation instruments (PA, Security Control Agreement (SCA), Special Security Agreement (SSA), or equivalent). Experience with proxy-agreement structures specifically is strongly preferred.
Proficiency with JPAS, DISS, and eQIP/SF-86 processing.
Active U.S. Government security clearance (Top Secret required); ability to obtain and maintain clearance at the level required for the role.
Demonstrated ability to operate independently and to enforce compliance boundaries with affiliate and parent company personnel. This role requires someone who is genuinely comfortable saying no when the rules require it.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in a FOCI-mitigated environment at a commercial software or technology company, particularly one with active DSCA oversight.
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
Familiarity with ITAR/EAR export control compliance as applied to software and SaaS products.
Industrial Security Professional (ISP) or similar certification.
Experience managing COMSEC accounts or working in a multi-facility environment.
You are
A compliance enforcer who leads with credibility, you've built a reputation for holding firm on security boundaries, even when it creates friction with senior stakeholders or affiliate personnel, and you do so with professionalism and clear regulatory grounding.
Independently operating and self-directing, you're comfortable owning a program end-to-end without a security team beneath you, proactively identifying gaps, drafting policies, and driving decisions without waiting for organizational scaffolding to be built around you.
Deeply fluent in FOCI mitigation frameworks, you're familiar with applying Proxy Agreement or Security Control Agreement structures to day-to-day operational decisions, including managing visit controls, affiliate communications, and annual DCSA reporting obligations.
A trusted cross-functional partner, you work naturally alongside legal counsel, General Managers, and executive governance bodies like a GSC, translating dense regulatory requirements into clear guidance that non-security stakeholders can act on.
Familiar with applying export control frameworks to technology products, you understand how ITAR and EAR obligations intersect with software or SaaS environments and can partner with counsel to ensure compliance without blocking the business from operating effectively.
Measures of Success
Within your first month, you will immerse yourself in CPS's existing Proxy Agreement, Affiliated Operations Plan, and all DCSA-mandated records, establish relationships with the Government Security Committee and key stakeholders, and conduct a comprehensive gap assessment of current FOCI compliance posture and personnel security rosters.
Within your third month, you will take full ownership of DCSA communications and annual compliance reporting, implement or strengthen visit controls and the Electronic Communications and Technology Control Plans, and launch a refreshed security education and awareness training program for cleared and uncleared personnel.
Within your sixth month, you will have matured the Insider Threat Program into a fully operational multi-disciplinary hub with established reporting mechanisms, completed a self-inspection cycle in preparation for DCSA facility reviews, and embedded yourself as a trusted advisor to the GSC on all security, ITAR/EAR, and FOCI mitigation matters, setting the long-term compliance foundation for CPS's growth in the public sector.
Compensation for this role
The standard base salary range for this position is $184,000.00 - $230,000.00 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.
In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

AI Field Champions: build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst.
Ops Transformation Plan: Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks.
AI Governance: Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy.
What You’ll Bring
Mid-Senior Experience: Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end.
AI Solutions Experience: Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation).
Cross-Functional Fluency: Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa.
Self-Sufficiency: Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction.
Organization & Execution: Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details.
Innovative Mindset: A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype.
Enablement/Sales Background: Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them.
GitLab Values Alignment: Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook.
About the team
The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. The enablement organization comprises enablement leads serving the CRO business functions, a centralized content group, AI tech resources, and an operations team.

title: Chief of Staff the CEO
description:
The job in one line
You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet.
Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running.
That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat.
What You'll Actually Do
Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for.
Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires.
Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time.
Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them.
Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan.
Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say.
What Success Looks Like In 90 Days
Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc
The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick
One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse
Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision
The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business
Requirements
What we're looking for
8 to 12 years of experience, including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec
Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both
Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting
Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do
You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck
Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it
Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. You'd rather own the outcome than protect the org chart
You use AI tooling daily to move faster on analysis, drafting, and research
Bonus
DTC, subscription, or CPG experience, especially a business with recurring revenue and real retention mechanics
Consulting, banking, or PE foundation plus real operating experience (we're not looking for one without the other)
You've built materials for and presented to a board or investors
SQL, or enough of it to be dangerous
What this role is not
Not an executive assistant. You are not managing a calendar or booking travel
Not a project manager who takes notes and updates a tracker
Not a strategy role that stops at the recommendation
Not a functional leadership role. You won't inherit a team on day one, though this role can grow into one
If you want a clear lane and a stable scope, this isn't it, and that's fine.
How To Apply
Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us:
One page on an operating cadence you built or ran. What existed before, what you changed, and what measurably improved as a result
A time you told an executive something they didn't want to hear. What you said, and what happened
Short answer: A subscription business is seeing retention slip. Five executives each have a confident, different theory as to why. You have two weeks. What do you look at first, how do you get to the actual answer, and how do you land it with a leadership team that's already made up its mind?
We read these carefully. Applications without them won't move forward.
Benefits
Strong base, performance bonus
Meaningful equity because we want you to own a piece of what you build
Health benefits + health stipend
Generous time off
Free product

title: Video Editor Reacts
description:
About Us
Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations. About the Role
MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention. What You'll Do
Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.
Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content. What We're Looking For
3+ years of professional video editing experience focused on high-pacing YouTube, commentary, or viral digital content.
Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, specifically with keyframing, motion tracking, masking, and dynamic linking.
Deep structural understanding of YouTube algorithm dynamics, Average View Duration (AVD), CTR, and retention curve analysis.
Mastery of dynamic sound design, audio leveling, and music curation to enhance comedic and emotional shifts.
A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions.
High feedback sensitivity, with the ability to handle rapid creative criticism constructively and pivot quickly.
Exceptional attention to detail, maintaining frame-by-frame precision in pacing and visual overlays.
Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows, including file compression, color correction, and final exports optimized for YouTube.
Extreme ownership over end-to-end video performance, production deadlines, and technical accuracy. Benefits The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team
We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.
Competitive Salary
Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life InsuranceÂ
Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)Â
401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
Company-provided technology packageÂ
Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

$70,000 â $80,000 annual base salary, plus a competitive bonus opportunity. Final compensation will be commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.
ABOUT THE COMPANY
ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.
More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.
ROLE OVERVIEW
ROAR Organic is seeking a hands-on Sales Leader to drive profitable growth in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.
The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. They are highly relationship-driven, resourceful, and action-oriented, with strong communication and organizational skills. This leader excels at building and implementing the strategies, tools, and processes needed to support sustained growth.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Deliver against Annual Operating Plan targets, including gross/net sales and trade spend objectives.
Grow distribution and topline revenue with a focus on regional and independent retailers.
Execute customer sales strategies, promotional calendars, and account plans.
Leverage distributer incentive programs and independent retailer promotional opportunities to drive sales.
Conduct weekly route rides with distributor sales representatives to support execution and identify growth opportunities.
Develop and own a field execution strategy based on weekly trend reports, promotional planners, and merchandising opportunities.
Manage and execute trade spend programs to drive profitable growth and promotional effectiveness.
Leverage syndicated data (IRI, SPINS) to communicate compelling, retailer-specific presentations.
Track, measure, and analyze performance metrics, including ROI.
Represent the brand at regional and national trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Minimum 2 years of CPG sales experience.
Strong understanding of the beverage and grocery landscape, including retailers and distributors.
Experience executing sales planning initiatives.
Creative, solutions-oriented problem solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated data tools (SPINS, IRI) preferred.
Ability to travel extensively as needed.
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.
